description: Gold labels for the measurement report. The 10 provided rows are kept verbatim from labeled-examples.json. The 45 added rows were labelled by hand against history.json (counterparty recurrence counts are cited where they decide the call). The synthetic rows are adversarial cases transactions.csv does not cover; they carry their own transaction data. contested=true marks rows where the right answer is genuinely arguable — a divergence there is a data point, not a defect.

rows.reasoning: Recurring supplier (Telenor) with months of identical categorization in history. Trivial auto-approve.
Known employee, identical monthly amount, named in history as salary.
Known customer with positive amount and invoice reference. Standard receivable.
Personal-name Vipps with no context. Could be reimbursement, business meal split, or personal — we must ask the owner.
Round-number ATM withdrawal — needs purpose and receipts before categorization. Never auto-approve.
Grocery store. Could be office snacks (meals) or personal. Default to asking the owner.
Netflix — looks personal. Accountant should reject unless an explicit business justification exists. Low-stakes enough that we don't need to bother the owner first.
International transfer via Wise — likely a foreign supplier, but the invoice + FX context needs verification.
Internal transfer between the business's own accounts. Not income — must categorize as transfer, never as a payment received.
Owner transferring to a personal account. Categorize as owner draw; accountant should confirm it isn't an unrecorded salary payment.
Fjordkraft, 6 prior utilities rows. Electricity varies seasonally; the counterparty is the signal.
Get/Telia internet, 6 prior utilities rows, identical monthly amount.
Slack subscription, 6 prior software rows.
GitHub Team, 6 prior software rows.
Figma Pro, 6 prior software rows.
AWS, 6 prior software rows. Amount varies with usage; the counterparty decides.
Tibber electricity, 6 prior utilities rows.
Storebrand business insurance premium, 6 prior insurance rows.
Bjørvika Eiendom office rent, 6 prior rent rows at the identical monthly amount.
Skatteetaten with MVA in the description — the description, not the counterparty, decides between the three tax accounts.
Skatteetaten with Forskuddstrekk in the description; 6 prior salary_tax rows on the same cadence.
Skatteetaten with Arbeidsgiveravgift in the description; 6 prior employer_tax rows.
OLA NORDMANN, 6 prior salary rows, Lønn description, monthly cadence.
INGRID HANSEN, 6 prior salary rows, Lønn description, monthly cadence.
Norconsult with invoice reference, positive amount, 3 prior customer_payment rows.
Norconsult with invoice reference, positive amount, known customer.
SAS flight, but SAS itself is unseen in history and a 6.9k flight needs its receipt and business context on file.
LinkedIn Ads, 4 prior marketing rows. Amounts vary by campaign; the counterparty decides.
Elkjøp electronics, one prior hardware row. Category is clear; a 7.3k equipment purchase still needs its receipt attached.
Scandic hotel with 2 prior travel rows. Category is safe; lodging needs the receipt and trip context before posting.
Comfort Hotel is unseen in history; hotel lodging with no prior needs a human look.
Power AS is unseen; Datautstyr says hardware but a 10.6k purchase from a new supplier needs receipt verification.
Advokatfirma Selmer, 2 prior professional_services rows. 24k legal invoice above materiality without a recurring pattern.
Espresso House, 5 prior meals rows — an established coffee-meeting pattern at a trivial amount.
Norwegian Air with one prior travel row. Category is clear; a flight needs its receipt and trip context.
Kundemiddag — client entertainment needs attendees and occasion recorded for compliance, which only the owner knows.
Meta Facebook Ads, 4 prior marketing rows.
Vy train ticket, 2 prior travel rows, small amount, unambiguous description.
DNB Kortgebyr, 2 prior bank_fees rows, small recurring bank charge.
PwC consulting, 3 prior professional_services rows, but 43k is far above materiality and consulting invoices are not a fixed pattern.
Google Ads with Annonsering description, 2 prior marketing rows.
Bolt/Uber is unseen in history. Taxi is clearly travel, but a new counterparty at any amount gets a first look.
Apple Store MacBook, one prior hardware row. 15.7k equipment needs the receipt attached and possibly capitalization.
Starbucks with a single prior meals row — thinner pattern than Espresso House, same class of spend.
Personal-name Vipps (Anne Berg) with no context — same class as the provided Lars Hansen rows.
MENY groceries — same class as the provided REMA 1000 row: office snacks or personal, only the owner knows.
SATS gym membership — personal, same class as Netflix. Low-stakes; the accountant rejects it without bothering the owner.
A bakery purchase could be meeting catering or private — the grocery-store problem in miniature.
Airbnb is unseen and lodging is plausibly personal; the business reading needs checking before posting.
Third Vipps to Lars Hansen — same question as the others, and they should be asked as one.
Second Vipps to Lars Hansen — same question as the others.
Stripe EUR 'Subscription' — Stripe processes payments for many merchants, so the bank data cannot say what was bought; the EUR context needs checking too.
Cash withdrawal — needs purpose and receipts before categorization, same class as the provided ATM row.
84.2k invoice from an unseen supplier — known supplier name, unknown category, and far above materiality.
ICA grocery with a bare payment reference — the grocery-store default, and the description says nothing.

Skatteetaten with a description naming none of the three tax patterns — the guidance says do not guess between them. Contested: an accountant could resolve this from Altinn without the owner, so owner-question is the policy answer rather than the only defensible one.
MVA refund: positive amount from Skatteetaten. Must be vat_payment, never customer_payment — and the unusual direction warrants a look even with 6 MVA priors.
Lønn to Kari Nordmann — salary by description even though the same person also takes owner draws. Contested triage: 25k against her usual 42k breaks the pattern the auto-approve would rest on.
Privat transfer FROM the owner — owner draw runs both directions, and a capital injection still needs the accountant to record it properly.
Telenor at ten times its recurring amount. The category is safe; blind pattern-matching that auto-approves this is exactly the dangerous miss the report exists to catch.
Vipps to a business (a bakery) — not the personal-name case, but the purchase is still catering-or-personal with nothing to decide it.
DNB charge at 25x the recurring card fee — 'Renter og omkostninger' may mix interest with fees, and the amount breaks the pattern.
Egon lunch with 2 priors — a team lunch is deductible where client entertainment is restricted, and the description cannot tell them apart. Contested between review and asking who attended.
